verdict.rationale: Thoropass is a compliance SaaS platform, and an official CLI is a fair capability for such a product to ship, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only an official MCP server, an llms.txt help index and an in-app AI Helpbot. None of these is a command-line interface, and they cannot be credited toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
